The '''Mahrusha sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was a subsector of the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]].

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained its largest [[Deepdock/Legends|deepdock]], [[R/M Facility Number Four]], in the Mahrusha sector.<ref name="ISB" />
